PBTA.App.Title: PBTA Manager
PBTA.List.DeleteConfirm: Delete {name} and all its posts? This can't be undone.
PBTA.List.NoPlayerActors: No player characters have been assigned.
PBTA.Thread.BlockedDraftNote: You can keep writing. It'll be saved as a draft, and you can post it once it's your turn.
PBTA.Thread.ForceCloseTooltip: Close the round even if someone hasn't posted yet.
PBTA.Thread.NoPosts: Nobody has posted yet. Be the first.
PBTA.Thread.NoSpeaker: You don't have a character in this episode.
PBTA.Thread.Placeholder: Write your post. *Italics* and **bold** are supported. Press Ctrl+Enter to post.
PBTA.Thread.SaveJournalTooltip: Save this episode as a journal entry in this world
PBTA.Dialog.Away.Note: While you're away, rounds will continue without waiting for you. You can catch up when you return.
PBTA.Dialog.Away.Title: Mark as Away
PBTA.Dialog.CloseRound.Note: You can record what happened this round. It will appear in the Campaign Log.
PBTA.Dialog.CloseRound.TextPlaceholder: Leave this blank if you don't want to add a summary.
PBTA.Dialog.CloseRound.Title: Close Round {number}
PBTA.Dialog.DeletePost.Title: Delete Post
PBTA.Dialog.DeleteSummary.Content: Delete this summary from the Campaign Log?
PBTA.Dialog.DeleteSummary.Title: Delete Summary
PBTA.Dialog.DiscardDraft.Title: Discard Draft
PBTA.Dialog.EditPost.Title: Edit Post
PBTA.Dialog.NewThread.Name: Episode Name
PBTA.Dialog.NewThread.Title: New Episode
PBTA.Dialog.Participants.Title: Episode Participants
PBTA.Dialog.Summary.Title: Write Summary
PBTA.Dialog.Visibility.Note: Choose who can read this episode. Participants can always post in it.
PBTA.Dialog.Visibility.Title: Episode Visibility
PBTA.Chronicle.CopiedToClipboard: The file couldn't be downloaded, so the Campaign Log was copied to the clipboard. Paste it into a text editor and save it as a .md file.
PBTA.Chronicle.EmptyHint: The GM can add a summary when starting a new round and highlight important posts with the star.
PBTA.Chronicle.ExportTooltip: Download the Campaign Log as Markdown
PBTA.Chronicle.Intro: Episode summaries and highlighted moments. Search every post using the box above.
PBTA.Chronicle.SaveJournalTooltip: Save the Campaign Log as a journal entry in this world
PBTA.Chronicle.SavedAsJournal: Campaign Log saved as journal entry "{name}".
PBTA.Summary.Label: Summary
PBTA.Clock.AutoAdvanceHint: Every time a round ends in the linked episode, this clock advances by one segment. The world keeps moving even when nobody is around.
PBTA.Clock.EmptyHint: Clocks track threats and long-term progress. Group them under a Front to keep related events together.
PBTA.Clock.Name: Name
PBTA.Codex.AliasesHint: Separate names with commas. They'll also be linked automatically in posts.
PBTA.Codex.AliasesPlaceholder: Mara, the innkeeper, the woman with the scar
PBTA.Codex.Autolink: Automatically link this name in posts
PBTA.Codex.AutolinkHint: Whenever this name appears in a post, it becomes a link to this entry. Disable this for very common names.
PBTA.Codex.EmptyHint: Add people, places, and factions as they appear. Their names will automatically become links in future posts.
PBTA.Codex.ImportActorsTooltip: Create codex entries for every NPC that doesn't already have one.
PBTA.Codex.Name: Name
PBTA.Codex.NoOthers: There are no other entries to link yet.
PBTA.Codex.SummaryPlaceholder: Runs the Raven's Tavern and hears everything
PBTA.Codex.SyncFromActor: Keep the name and image synced with the actor
PBTA.DiscordLinks.Intro: Paste each player's Discord user ID so the bridge knows who's posting. In Discord, go to User Settings → Advanced, enable Developer Mode, then right-click a user and choose Copy User ID.
PBTA.Chat.DeadlineReached: {thread}: this round has been open for {days} day(s). Still waiting on: {names}
PBTA.Chat.RoundComplete: {thread}: Round {number} is complete. Everyone has posted.
PBTA.Discord.DeadlineReached: ⚠️ **{thread}** — this round has been open for {days} day(s). Still waiting on: {names}
PBTA.Discord.RoundAutoClosed: ⏭️ **{thread}** — Round {number} closed automatically after reaching the time limit.
PBTA.Discord.RoundComplete: ✅ **{thread}** — Round {number} is complete. Everyone has posted.
PBTA.Settings.ActorSync.Hint: Creates a codex entry whenever you create an NPC actor with no player owner. New entries are GM-only by default. If you also delete entries with their actors, any notes you've added will be lost.
PBTA.Settings.ActorSync.Name: Create Codex Entries for NPCs
PBTA.Settings.AutoClose.Hint: Automatically closes a round once the limit above is reached. Set the limit to 0 to disable this feature.
PBTA.Settings.AutoClose.Name: Automatically Close Stalled Rounds
PBTA.Settings.DeadlineDays.Hint: Notify the GM when a round has been open this long and someone still hasn't posted. Set to 0 to disable.
PBTA.Settings.DeadlineDays.Name: Days Before a Round Is Considered Stalled
PBTA.Settings.DefaultMode.Name: Default Mode for New Episodes
PBTA.Settings.DiscordForum.Hint: The bridge creates one forum post per episode in this channel. Right-click the forum channel in Discord and choose Copy Channel ID. Leave this empty to disable the bridge.
PBTA.Settings.DiscordForum.Name: Discord Forum Channel ID
PBTA.Settings.DiscordMirror.Hint: Public episodes are automatically mirrored to Discord. Private and hidden episodes are never mirrored.
PBTA.Settings.DiscordMirror.Name: Mirror New Episodes to Discord
PBTA.Settings.Language.Hint: Choose the language used by this module. "Automatic" follows your Foundry language.
PBTA.Settings.Language.Name: Module Language
PBTA.Settings.MobileLayout.Hint: Expands this module's windows to fill the screen and uses larger touch controls. "Automatic" enables it on narrow or touch devices.
PBTA.Settings.MobileLayout.Name: Mobile Layout
PBTA.Settings.NotifyPost.Hint: Send a Discord notification whenever someone posts in a episode.
PBTA.Settings.NotifyPost.Name: Notify Discord of New Posts
PBTA.Settings.NotifyRound.Hint: Send a notification when everyone in a episode has posted.
PBTA.Settings.NotifyRound.Name: Notify Discord When a Round Ends
PBTA.Settings.NotifyTurn.Hint: Only applies to episodes using turn order.
PBTA.Settings.NotifyTurn.Name: Notify Discord of Turn Changes
PBTA.Settings.Webhook.Hint: Paste the webhook URL for the channel where notifications should be sent. Leave this empty to disable Discord notifications. If you use the Discord bridge, leave it empty: the bridge already posts to Discord and you would get every message twice.
PBTA.Settings.Webhook.Name: Discord Webhook URL
PBTA.Error.EmptyEditHint: The message can't be empty. Use the delete button if you want to remove it.
PBTA.Error.NoSocketlib: PBTA Manager requires the "socketlib" module to be enabled.
PBTA.Error.NoTurnParticipants: There are no participants to start turn order.
PBTA.Error.NobodyPending: Nobody is waiting to post in this episode.
PBTA.Error.NotParticipant: Your character isn't part of this episode.
PBTA.Error.NotThread: This document isn't a PBTA Manager episode.
PBTA.Error.OnlyGMClocks: Only the GM can manage clocks.
PBTA.Error.OnlyGMCodex: Only the GM can manage the codex.
PBTA.Error.OnlyGMDeleteSummary: Only the GM can delete summaries.
PBTA.Error.OnlyGMEditSummary: Only the GM can edit summaries.
PBTA.Error.OnlyGMPin: Only the GM can highlight posts.
PBTA.Error.OnlyGMSummary: Only the GM can write summaries.
PBTA.Error.OnlyOwnDelete: You can only delete your own posts.
PBTA.Error.OnlyOwnEdit: You can only edit your own posts.
PBTA.Error.RoundComplete: This round is over. Wait for the GM to start the next one.
PBTA.Error.SecretNoTargets: Select at least one recipient for the private message.
